mapper.select: SELECT id, city_name, province, code, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.city ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, city_name, province, code, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.city WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT id, city_name, province, code, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.city WHERE code=#{code} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.city(city_name, province, code) VALUES(#{cityName}, #{province}, #{code})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.city SET city_name=#{cityName}, province=#{province}, code=#{code}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.city SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.city WHERE deleted = 0
